answer_sql:
SELECT
  t0.customer_key
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS t0
WHERE
  t0.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  t0.customer_key
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM t0.order_date)) = 4
ORDER BY
  t0.customer_key
